description: Behaviour cloning of Bot: Regular from 90 recorded matches against Bot: Rookie (54 training, 18 validation, 18 test matches). Test-match accuracy: move 67 percent, button 83 percent (majority-class baseline 40 and 76). In 12 test matches against Rookie it won 8 of 12, as did the teacher (reward 83.0 vs 64.0, paired difference not significant). Samples its actions like the teacher's frequencies.
name: Regular Clone (BC)

scenario.help: A scripted opponent that walks in and jabs on a rhythm. Learn to block, punish and survive.
scenario.name: Sparring: jabber
